definition.simple: All the different steps a farmer takes, from preparing the soil to storing the harvest, to grow food.
definition.academic: The various activities or tasks which a farmer performs over a period of time to cultivate a crop are referred to as agricultural practices.

common_misconceptions: People think farming is just putting seeds in the ground and waiting. It actually involves a complex, scientific sequence of steps.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student: 'If you were to grow a plant in your garden, what is the very first thing you would do to the dirt?'
